children: ASOF HOS GP, LLC disclosed ownership of 23.7% of Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc.’s common stock. The position stems from the Helix–Hornbeck merger that closed on September 1, 2026 and was reported on September 9, 2026. The sizable stake, including shares underlying Jones Act warrants, gives the Ares-led group the right to name two directors.

ASOF HOS GP, LLC and affiliated Ares funds plan to stay actively engaged and may buy or sell more shares, subject to Jones Act limits and deal agreements. Under a Securityholders Agreement, Ares can appoint two directors as long as its group owns at least 20% of the common stock, including warrant shares. “Ares may designate two directors while its group owns at least 20%,” and it named Aaron Rosen and Kevin Meyers to the board at closing.

The group agreed to key limits during a standstill period, including a cap that prevents ownership from exceeding 30% without company consent. “The group will not knowingly cross 30% during the standstill,” and it accepted a 180-day lock-up while receiving customary registration rights to facilitate future sales, including a path to sell warrant shares through a registered offering.

ASOF HOS GP, LLC is a Delaware limited liability company that serves as general partner to Ares-managed investment vehicles holding Hornbeck shares. Ares Management Corporation is a global alternative asset manager known for credit, private equity, and real assets strategies. Ares often invests through opportunistic and special situations funds that can pair equity with structured and warrant positions.
